consequence.statement: Lifecycler configurations now correctly reference valid IPv6 address and port combinations, fixing previous invalid references.

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 fixes lifecycler configurations to properly reference valid IPv6 address and port combinations.

decision.reason: [ev-3881a5911482] and [ev-7e7223c9cf76] say all LifecyclerConfig constructors now use net.JoinHostPort to combine the instance address and port. Before this, only the distributor path handled IPv6, and other components using BasicLifecycler left the address/port combination to the user. [ev-87ec3af1d884] shows the change touches the distributor, ruler and shared ring configs. The evidence describes a fix that makes IPv6 work and says nothing fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so an action-eligible kind is not supported. A low-severity behavior-change (review) fits a fix that changes how the ring address is formed.
